verdict.rationale: Lago supports parts of data export. Invoices can be downloaded or pulled as invoice objects (lago-docs-5). Analytics dashboards export to CSV (lago-docs-15). Every endpoint is exposed through a documented API and an OpenAPI schema, so data can be pulled programmatically (lago-docs-1, lago-docs-16, lago-probe-3). The self-hosted Docker option keeps data under the operator's control (lago-docs-11). However, nothing in the evidence describes a dedicated bulk export of all subscriptions and usage records, and nothing addresses moving stored payment methods to another provider. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of subscriptions and usage events, payment-method/token portability to another provider, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full exit migration.
